description: P013 GPU preverify task material: 13 buggy snapshots + 13 criterion test files + 13 replay edit files + criteria-index.json + tasks-13.jsonl. Built on CPU, consumed read-only by preverify.py on GPU (no model, no harness, no network).
layout: snapshots/<instance_id>.tar.gz (13 files, ~46MB total; largest pydicom ~6MB each) | criteria/test_p013_*.py (13 criterion files; test_patch source, added to tests/ only, never a source fix) | criteria/replay/<instance_id>.json (13 teacher-edit op files, str_replace/create only) | criteria/criteria-index.json (task_id -> test_file / f2p_node map) | tasks-13.jsonl (task_id / instance_id / base_commit / snapshot name)
pack_steps: cp criteria-src/test_p013_*.py <ds>/criteria/; cp criteria-src/replay/*.json <ds>/criteria/replay/; cp criteria-src/criteria-index.json <ds>/criteria/
cp tasks-13.jsonl <ds>/; verify: 13 snapshots + 13 criteria + 13 replays + index + tasks file; record sha256 per file in dataset manifest
title: P013 Preverify Task Material
